title: Venue hire
intro: Hire a historic hall or a meeting room at Toynbee Hall in East London. Your booking supports our charitable work.

sections.text: Host your event at an iconic venue in east London

Welcome to Toynbee Hall – one of the most historic and affordable halls for hire in London. Located in the heart of East London, just minutes from Aldgate East Underground Station and Liverpool Street, we offer flexible, accessible and character-filled spaces for every kind of event.
Explore our event spaces
Explore our flexible event spaces in East London – from grand halls to intimate meeting rooms. Each space combines historic character with modern facilities for an unforgettable event.

sections.text: Take a 3D virtual tour of our venue

Step inside Toynbee Hall, a Grade II listed building in the heart of East London. Since 1884, Toynbee Hall has been a hub for social innovation. Our venue combines heritage architecture with contemporary facilities, offering an inspiring environment for meetings, conferences, workshops, and private events. With easy access from Aldgate East station, our venue blends accessibility with history to create a truly unique London event experience.
Versatile venue hire for all types of events

We offer flexible event spaces and halls for hire in London with capacities ranging from small private meeting rooms to large lecture halls, making us one of the most versatile venues in London. No matter what your event – our event spaces can cater to your needs.
CONFERENCES
Seminars, lectures, training days and more
MEETINGS
Board meetings, away days and more
CORPORATE EVENTS
Cocktail receptions, dinners and more
WEDDINGS
Civil ceremonies, private celebrations and more
PERFORMANCES
Talks, book signings, film productions and more
Trusted by organisations in every sector

Trusted by leading organisations, charities and creative brands, Toynbee Hall has hosted events for a wide range of partners including local authorities, universities, creative agencies and global firms.

sections.text: My experience at Toynbee Hall was brilliant!

We used the Lecture Hall and it was perfect for our event. We were also equipped with AV systems which were at a high spec and exactly what we needed. Ben & Whitney are a fantastic team and they were so supportive on the day of our events, nothing was too much to ask! I will be using Toynbee Hall for future events for sure as it has suitable spaces for all sorts of events such as workshops, conferences & training days.
An event venue that gives back

Every booking at Toynbee Hall helps fund our work fighting poverty and injustice across East London. Our venue hire revenue gets reinvested into our charitable activities, and directly supports free advice services, youth programmes and community projects – making your booking part of your organisation’s social impact goals and corporate social footprint. By hiring our event spaces, you’re helping to create a fairer future for the people of east London.
